title: Doodling Daydream Octopus
statement: A thumb-sized, opalescent octopus who rearranges pebbles and shells into tiny spirals, gardens, and questions by day, then glows soft gold and drifts upside-down to dream among the moonlit kelp. Its tank is a quiet, sun-dappled reading nook of glass orbs, mossy arches, and bubbles that pop like whispered ideas.
